snippet.title: Operation Desert Storm (Bungie's 2nd Game)
snippet.description: This is the first commerical game made by bungie software. it was programmed soley by Alaxander Seriopian for the mac back in 1991. Aside from giving out trivial knowledge of middle eastern affairs at that time, game play in my opinion is fairly mediocre.
